[But to tell you the truth, English only gets polished when you speak more and practice a little every day. That's why I tried the 'Seekho' app. There is a whole category for learning English on this app. Daily use English, office English, spoken English, all in short and simple videos. No time pressure on anyone. Watch whenever you want. Just take 15 minutes daily and invest in learning English. Slowly confidence comes, mistakes reduce, and a day comes when English flows without even thinking. Whether it's a night shift or a day job, schedule is not important, consistency is important. So do you also want to improve your English while being busy? Then download the 'Seekho' app today and start practicing today.]

summary: A humorous Marathi skit highlights the difficulty of learning English with a busy schedule or night shifts. The presenter introduces the Seekho app, which offers short, flexible videos for daily and office English.
